content.text:
Design findings and sketch sent to `/root`. No files were changed.

The main ownership boundary is clear: funders remain resolved identities; a separate alias-group owner should represent accepted transitive links. Persist exact alias edges for details, and derive group membership during ingestion so search and details share one graph interpretation. Recursive query-time closure is a viable alternative, but risks duplicating graph semantics across search and details.
